:registerPopup({
        checkPoint = PCP.CLIMB_TOWER_TRIGGER,
        stages     = { PopStage.STAGE_TWO, PopStage.STAGE_FOUR },
        check      = function()
            if not self:isEnabled() then return false end
            -- 正式期和领奖期各弹一次，本地缓存记录（needTime=false 跨日持久），key 拼入 periodId 按期隔离
            local periodId           = tostring(self:getPeriodId() or "")
            local TRIGGER_MAIN_KEY   = "climb_tower_trigger_main_" .. periodId
            local TRIGGER_REWARD_KEY = "climb_tower_trigger_reward_" .. periodId
            -- 正式期：本期正式期内未弹过
            if self:isInMainTime() and self:getTotalTickets() > 0 then
                return (self:getLocalCache(TRIGGER_MAIN_KEY, false) or 0) < 1
            end
            -- 领奖期：本期领奖期内未弹过
            if self:getModel():isInRewardTime() and self:getTotalTickets() > 0 then
                return (self:getLocalCache(TRIGGER_REWARD_KEY, false) or 0) < 1
            end
            return false
        end,
        creator    = function(_, onPopOver)
            return function()
                -- 正式期和领奖期各弹一次，本地缓存记录（needTime=false 跨日持久），key 拼入 periodId 按期隔离
                local periodId           = tostring(self:getPeriodId() or "")
                local TRIGGER_MAIN_KEY   = "climb_tower_trigger_main_" .. periodId
                local TRIGGER_REWARD_KEY = "climb_tower_trigger_reward_" .. periodId
                -- 本地记录本期弹出，防止重复弹
                if self:isInMainTime() then
                    self:setLocalCache(TRIGGER_MAIN_KEY, false, 1)
                else
                    self:setLocalCache(TRIGGER_REWARD_KEY, false, 1)
                end
                self:openActivity(onPopOver)
            end
        end,
    }

                    and self:_tryDailyPopGiftPaenlCond()
            end,

                return function()
                    local isOpenedGiftPanel = false
                    local function closePanelCallback()
                        self:getGiftModule():setAutoPopup()
                        safeRunCall(onPopOver)
                    end
                    local function openedCallback(ret)
                        isOpenedGiftPanel = ret
                        if not isOpenedGiftPanel then
                            closePanelCallback()
                        end
                    end
                    self:tryDownLoadRes(true):next(function()
                        if self._isCreaingNewCardPanel then
                            closePanelCallback()
                            return
                        end
                        self:openNewCardPanel(closePanelCallback, {}, false, openedCallback)
                    end, function()
                        closePanelCallback()
                    end)
                end
            end,
        }

                    local currentInfo = self:getProgressTipInfo()
                    if not currentInfo or not currentInfo.tier then
                        safeRunCall(onPopOver)
                        return
                    end

                    local icon = self.iconModule:getActivityIcon()
                    local shown = false
                    if icon and icon.showProgressTip and not icon.isDisposed then
                        shown = icon:showProgressTip(currentInfo) == true
                    end
                    if shown then
                        local currentPopKey = self:_getProgressTipPopLocalKey(currentInfo.tier)
                        self:setFlagToLocalByKey(currentPopKey, false, true)
                        self._progressTipShowed = true
                    end
                    safeRunCall(onPopOver)
                end
            end,
        }

:registerPopup({
        checkPoint = PopupCheckPoint.MAGIC_RUSH_STAGE4_POP,
        actId = self:getConst().actId,
        stages = {AutoPopupConst.PopStage.STAGE_FOUR},
        check = function()
            -- isEnabled 已包含 isDataEnabled 与活动时间窗（主时间/领奖期）。
            if not self:isActivitySupported(self:getConst().actId) then return false end
            if not self:isEnabled() then return false end
            if _G.getTopLevelId() < 101 then return false end
            -- R1/R2/R3 分组互斥（由 isNewVersion 与 magic_1v1_pop 开关决定）。
            -- R1：每日最多弹出 1 次；R2：不限制；R3：新版本流程。
            if rule == "R1" then
                return not self:getDailyPopupFlag()
                    and self:isInPrepare()
                    and not self:shouldReduceAutoPopup()
            end
            if rule == "R3" then
                -- 每日主面板未弹过则弹；已弹过仅展示获胜结算。
                if not self:getDailyPopupFlag() then
                    return not self:shouldReduceAutoPopup()
                end
                if self:isToBeSettledNormal() then
                    local myScore, enemyScore = self:getMatchScore()
                    return self:checkWinState(myScore, enemyScore) == self:getConst().MatchState.WIN
                end
                return false
            end
            -- R2：不限制次数
            return self:isInPrepare() and not self:shouldReduceAutoPopup()
        end,
        pop = function(_, onPopOver)
            return function()
                -- R1 弹出即落当日标记，供 check 拦截同日再次弹出。
                if rule == "R1" then
                    self:setDailyPopupFlag()
                end
                self:openActivity({
                    failCallback = onPopOver,
                    endCallback = onPopOver,
                })
            end
        end,
    }
